slot.brief: Arrangement of letters of a word with two specific people/letters never adjacent; total arrangements minus the fused-block count.

stem: How many arrangements of the letters of TRAIL have T and L nonadjacent?

verdicts.working: Total arrangements: 5! = 120. With T and L adjacent: 2 × 4! = 48. Nonadjacent: 120 − 48 = 72.

working:
Total arrangements $=5!=120$.\nAdjacent arrangements: treat T and L as a block, giving $2\times4!=48$.\nRequired number $=120-48=72$.

Independent check: Total arrangements: 5! = 120. With T and L adjacent: 2 × 4! = 48. Nonadjacent: 120 − 48 = 72.
solution:
Total arrangements of the five distinct letters are $5!$. If T and L are adjacent, treat them as one block; the block can be ordered in $2$ ways:
$$5!-2\cdot4!=120-48=72.$$
